lineageStatus.rationale: The 2023 Delimitation in Assam underwent extensive territorial reshuffling: multiple constituencies were renamed, merged, split, or newly formed (e.g., Baokhungri, Birsing Jarua, Pakabetbari). 1:1 name-matching across regimes is strictly invalid. Cross-regime lineage graph edges remain intentionally pending until official ECI/CEO territorial concordance tables are published.
